rule: A per-player progress ladder in one state value (FLAG0, steps 0 to 7). Each step fires on a counted state (treasury tiles, lair tiles, garden tiles, creature count, first-wave win), never on a clock alone. Game-turn timers are short pauses inside a step (hint at 600 turns, first wave at 800, lord 500 turns after the first win). Gold counters gate hints and the lair. Tutorial buttons flash until the player clicks that control. The first fight is capped to level-1 enemies that do not flee when wounded. A named rival line after the first win precedes the arrival of the rival.
keep: One goal on screen at a time, changed by state
Flash the control until the player clicks it (show, don't tell)
Counted-action gates (kills, gold, loot, creature count) rather than clock
Capped first fight with a named rival line after the win and an arrival timer
Cap growth across stages (7, then 14 in level 2)
Safety net for a stuck resource (imp fallback)
change: Do not gate on exactly the cap; do not make the first wave wait on a stalled stage without a hint
First fight in the ring: one attacker, then two, then three (MAX_ATTACKERS = 3)
Town hall services introduced one at a time (bank, shop, trainer), each flashed until visited
Replace gold gates with kill and loot gates; one-line hint text at 375 wide
Server ticks and a grace timer for pacing instead of turn-count pauses
look_test: Two 90-second ring clips at 375 wide. A: first fight with three attackers at once and no hint. B: one attacker, the attack control flashing until the first tap, one line after the first kill, a champion banner with a 10-second timer, then two attackers. Dom judges whether the first tap came without reading, whether the first kill was readable, and whether the champion line makes him want the next fight.
